sources.title: The Schengen area
sources.publisher: European Commission, Directorate-General for Migration and Home Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: European Commission Directorate-General for Migration and Home Affairs policy portal.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ireland has opted out of the Schengen Agreement and continues to operate its own visa and border policies.

policies.title: Annex I third-country ordinary passports: visa required
policies.summary: Ordinary-passport holders from the Annex I cohort require a visa for short travel to every destination in this EU/Schengen batch.
conditions: Cohort is the current Annex I country list, normalized to the repository's passport codes.
Vanuatu was transferred from Annex II to Annex I by Regulation (EU) 2025/11; its visa requirement took effect on 3 February 2025.
This ordinary-passport cohort does not encode Member State exceptions for diplomatic, service, official or special passports permitted under Article 6.
The destination cohort is the batch's 29 Schengen countries plus Cyprus; Ireland is outside this policy's scope.

policies.title: Annex II ordinary passports without listed document qualification: visa exempt
policies.summary: The listed Annex II ordinary-passport cohort is visa-exempt for short stays in this EU/Schengen destination batch.
conditions: Applies to nationals listed in Annex II holding ordinary passports; separately qualified Annex II entries are modelled in their own policies.
Visa exemption is for stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period.
The destination cohort is the batch's 29 Schengen countries plus Cyprus; Ireland is outside this policy's scope.

policies.title: Annex II ordinary passports subject to entry into force of a visa-waiver agreement
policies.summary: These Annex II entries are visa-exempt only when the underlying EU bilateral visa-waiver agreement has entered into force.
conditions: Each Annex II entry is expressly conditional on the entry into force of an agreement on visa-exemption between the European Union and the relevant country.
Visa exemption, once the agreement condition is met, is for stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period.
No individual bilateral agreement entry-into-force instrument was re-opened in this cohort pass; confirm each before relying on this normalized outcome.

policies.title: Annex II biometric ordinary passports: visa exempt
policies.summary: The listed Annex II nationals are visa-exempt only when holding a biometric passport compliant with the relevant ICAO standard.
conditions: Applies only to biometric passports meeting the ICAO standards identified in the Annex II footnotes for the relevant issuing country.
Non-biometric passports are not established as visa-exempt by this policy.
Visa exemption is for stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period.

policies.title: Georgian biometric ordinary passports: visa exempt
policies.summary: Georgian ordinary passports are visa-exempt only if biometric and ICAO-compliant; the 2026 suspension is limited to non-ordinary passport classes.
conditions: Applies only to biometric passports issued by Georgia that meet International Civil Aviation Organization standards.
The temporary suspension beginning 6 March 2026 applies to diplomatic, service and official passports, not ordinary passports.
Visa exemption is for stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period.

policies.title: Serbian biometric ordinary passports, including Coordination Directorate passports: visa exempt
policies.summary: Serbian ordinary passports are visa-exempt only when biometric and ICAO-compliant, including those issued by the Serbian Coordination Directorate.
conditions: Applies only to biometric passports issued by Serbia, including passports issued by the Serbian Coordination Directorate, that meet ICAO standards.
Visa exemption is for stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period.

policies.title: Kosovo biometric ordinary passports: visa exempt
policies.summary: Kosovo ordinary passports are visa-exempt only when biometric and ICAO-compliant; the Annex II waiver has applied since 1 January 2024.
conditions: Applies only to biometric passports issued by Kosovo that meet International Civil Aviation Organization standards.
The waiver applies from the date the European Travel Information and Authorisation System starts operations, or from 1 January 2024, whichever occurs first.
Visa exemption is for stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period.

policies.title: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region passports: visa exempt
policies.summary: Visa exemption applies only to holders of a Hong Kong Special Administrative Region passport.
conditions: Applies only to holders of a Hong Kong Special Administrative Region passport; it does not establish a rule for other British or Chinese travel documents.
Visa exemption is for stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period.

policies.title: Macao Special Administrative Region passports: visa exempt
policies.summary: Visa exemption applies only to holders of a Macao Special Administrative Region passport.
conditions: Applies only to holders of a Macao Special Administrative Region passport; it does not establish a rule for other Chinese travel documents.
Visa exemption is for stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period.

policies.title: Taiwan passports containing an identity card number: visa exempt
policies.summary: Visa exemption applies only to Taiwan passports containing an identity card number.
conditions: Applies only to holders of Taiwan passports that include an identity card number; it does not establish a rule for other Taiwan travel documents.
Visa exemption is for stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period.

policies.title: United Kingdom passports other than excluded British national classes: visa exempt
policies.summary: The Annex II United Kingdom entry is visa-exempt but expressly excludes the British national classes listed in Annex II.
conditions: The Annex II United Kingdom entry does not apply to British Overseas Territories citizens, British Overseas citizens, British subjects or British protected persons.
This policy models the repository's GB ordinary-passport code only; excluded British national classes require separate document/status evidence.
Visa exemption is for stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period.
